name: Drake Park (Burlington)
note: City of Burlington park on the Neosho River just below the City Dam (a low weir), off Cross Street from US-75; the town's other campground is Kelley Park, 1.7 km south. Eight concrete back-in stalls side by side along the park road; a 2024 Campendium reviewer fitted a 38-ft Class A at site 2 and needed blocks to level, and the city gives no length. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of Burlington parks page + its camping sheet (Revision 4-11-2016, still the posted sheet), read 2026-11-05: 'DRAKE PARK 8 Campsites, All with Electric (20 amp and 30 amp only), All with Water', self-pay $10/night, no reservations; Campendium review by a 38-ft Class A that stayed May 23-25 2024 at site 2 for $10 confirms it operates; separate place from Kelley Park 2167 (1.7 km apart, own entrance off Cross St/Old Mill Rd vs S 3rd St) -> real local RV campground (public, no price gate)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-05: Esri World Imagery (current, 220 m frame at 38.2050,-95.7312) shows the 8 angled concrete stalls on the east side of the park road, backed by a 30-40 m band of riverbank trees, then a gravel bar and the Neosho tailwater; the City Dam weir is ~60-90 m NNE of the north stalls. Leaf-off Esri Wayback 2018-01-26 (WV02) shows that band as open bare deciduous woods, water ~33 m behind the stall backs and the spillway pool ~40-60 m NE. Campendium firsthand review (site 2, May 2024, 38-ft Class A): 'sites overlook the Neosho River, with riverbank access and an upriver view of a large spillway'; a 2022 reviewer: 'campsites back up to the river'. The tree band is a continuous screen, so not riverfront; filtered view through it = riverview. Below-dam check: the stalls are downstream of a low weir (no berm), judged only against the tailwater river; DEM 313 m at the stalls vs 302 m on the water (90-m DEM, coarse). No official per-site map exists.

fees.note: City of Burlington: RV camping $10 a night at the self-pay station (the rate set April 2016, still the city's posted rate in November 2026; a camper paid $10 in May 2024).

fees_source: https://burlingtonkansas.gov/city-departments-services/parks/ ('REGULAR RATE PER NIGHT ... DRAKE PARK / CITY DAM $ 10 SELF-PAY STATION'), read 2026-11-05; Campendium review stay May 23-25 2024 '$10/night'

booking.note: Choose a site and pay at the self-pay station before setting up; put the receipt on the site's electric box. After 14 days, 7 days away from city campsites before returning.

booking_source: https://burlingtonkansas.gov/city-departments-services/parks/ ('RV PARKING / CAMPING : NO RESERVATIONS'; 'Self-Pay stations have been installed at Kelley Park and Drake Park/City Dam') + https://burlingtonkansas.gov/wp-content/uploads/2013/01/RV-Camping-Drake-and-Kelley-10-Nightly-effective-April-2016.pdf ('RESERVATIONS NOT ACCEPTED.'; 'LIMIT: 14 DAYS (Must leave city-owned campsites for 7 days before returning.)'), read 2026-11-05
rvlife: not listed (RV Life Algolia, 3 km around the pin, 2026-11-05: only Kelley Park and BLB Properties)
